player_prompt.intro:
Wee mwini {player_id} mu SimpleTak.
Pa bodi, mawu anu anagonja '{player_stone}' ndipo mawu a mwamene anagonja '{opponent_stone}'.

Pa mingu anu, chitani chigumu chimodzimodzi (kwa inekesi yake ya nambari) ndi ukalowe mwau wanu kumo.
Koma ife, '[12]' kukalowesa mwau wanu m'chigumu 12.

Lengo lanu ni kujumana na mawu anu ngati linalowa miwa miwili ikung'ana pa bodi (juu-kummwela kapena kumanzere-kumalire).

invalid_move.cell_out_of_range: Nambala ya selo yambura kugwiriska nchito {cell_num}. Yifike pakati pa 0 na {max_board_num}.
invalid_move.cell_already_occupied: Cella {cell_num} yili kale na munthu munyake. Sankhani selo lawaka.

outcome.winner: Mchezaji {current_player_id} ('{symbol}') aliunganisha kingo mbili za bodo!
